name: GrokBot Optimizer
tagline: Audits a whole fleet of bots against the rules you set for them
description: Aimed at anyone running more than a handful of bots at once. It takes stock of who is on the roster, what each one is meant to be doing and what runs on a timer, weighs all of that against the operating principles you have written down, and points out overlap or drift. Every change arrives as a proposal you approve.
author: Robert
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
